tasks.title: CREW_AI_KEY config entry + Google-LLM classifier helper
tasks.parallelism_notes: Root task. Owns conf.py and creates credentials.py; no other task writes either file before it.

tasks.title: apply_google_api_key() — non-mutating credential injector
tasks.parallelism_notes: Calls is_google_llm and reads _CREDENTIAL_KWARGS from TASK-3451 (packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/bots/flows/crew/credentials.py); also appends to the same credentials.py and the same test_crew_credentials.py that TASK-3451 creates.

tasks.title: AgentCrew.__init__(google_api_key=) + the three default-Google-client sites
tasks.parallelism_notes: Imports GOOGLE_PROVIDER_KEYS from TASK-3451 (packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/bots/flows/crew/credentials.py) to gate the llm-string branch of AgentCrew.__init__.

tasks.title: AgentCrew.from_definition(google_api_key=) — per-agent injection + forwarding
tasks.parallelism_notes: Calls apply_google_api_key from TASK-3452 (credentials.py); forwards google_api_key to the AgentCrew.__init__ parameter TASK-3453 adds, and edits the same file (packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/bots/flows/crew/crew.py) as TASK-3453.

tasks.title: BotManager._create_crew_from_definition passes CREW_AI_KEY
tasks.parallelism_notes: Passes the google_api_key keyword TASK-3454 adds to AgentCrew.from_definition (packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/bots/flows/crew/crew.py); resolves it via get_crew_google_api_key, which reaches it transitively through TASK-3451.

tasks.title: CrewHandler._create_crew_from_definition applies CREW_AI_KEY
tasks.parallelism_notes: Calls apply_google_api_key and get_crew_google_api_key from TASK-3452/3451 (credentials.py), and passes the google_api_key keyword TASK-3453 adds to AgentCrew.__init__. Does not touch crew.py, so it is file-disjoint from TASK-3454.

tasks.title: End-to-end test — a handler-built Google agent's client uses CREW_AI_KEY
tasks.parallelism_notes: Exercises the CrewHandler._create_crew_from_definition wiring TASK-3456 adds (packages/ai-parrot-server/src/parrot/handlers/crew/handler.py); the test asserts nothing until that call site injects the key.

tasks.title: Document CREW_AI_KEY
tasks.parallelism_notes: No code edge: the behaviour documented is fixed by the approved spec, not by the implementation. Owns docs/crew_handler.md and docs/config.md, which no other task touches.
